2608.31066.title: Every Token Leaves a Ripple in the Stream of Thought: Eliciting Model-Internal Token Saliency for Chain-of-Thought Compression
2608.31066.paper_summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning improves multi-step problem solving, but long reasoning traces inflate inference cost. Token-level CoT compression reduces this cost by pruning full reasoning chains into shorter traces for model adaptation, making token selection the central challenge. Existing methods often rely on external scorers or heuristic signals only indirectly tied to the model's internal answer computation. We instead adopt a model-internal perspective: as the model forms an answer, each reasoning token leaves a ripple in the residual stream, the model's \emph{stream of thought}, and the magnitude of this ripple reflects the token's contribution to the answer computation. Building on this view, we propose \textsc{MIST} (Model-Internal Saliency for Token-level CoT compression), which defines token importance along two complementary axes: \emph{necessity}, the drop in answer likelihood when a token's internal contribution is removed, and \emph{sufficiency}, the gain in answer likelihood when that contribution alone is provided. Combining the two yields a unified importance score for pruning. Across four reasoning benchmarks and four models, \textsc{MIST} consistently outperforms baseline methods, suggesting that model-internal saliency provides an effective proxy for reasoning-token importance.
2608.31066.paper_summary_zh: Chain-of-thought (CoT) 推理改善了多步驟問題解決，但長的推理痕跡會增加推理成本。<lb/>基於標記的 CoT 壓縮通過將完整的推理鏈修剪為較短的痕跡來降低這一成本，以便進行模型適應，使得標記選擇成為中心挑戰。<lb/>現有的方法通常依賴於外部評分器或與模型內部答案計算僅間接相關的啟發式信號。<lb/>我們則採取模型內部的視角：當模型形成答案時，每個推理標記在殘差流中留下漣漪，即模型的 \emph{思維流}，這個漣漪的大小反映了該標記對答案計算的貢獻。<lb/>基於這一觀點，我們提出了 \textsc{MIST}（模型內部標記重要性以進行標記級 CoT 壓縮），它沿著兩個互補的軸定義標記的重要性：\emph{必要性}，即當去除一個標記的內部貢獻時答案的可能性下降，以及\emph{充分性}，即當僅提供該貢獻時答案的可能性上升。<lb/>將這兩者結合起來，可以得到一個統一的重要性分數以進行修剪。<lb/>在四個推理基準和四個模型中，\textsc{MIST} 始終優於基線方法，這表明模型內部的顯著性為推理標記的重要性提供了一個有效的代理。
